item.title: shinygenui: Generative UI for Shiny
item.description: Sketched user interface skeletons. Procedurally generated with p5.brush.skeleton. It’s my pleasure to share that shinygenui is now on CRAN. It brings generative UI to Shiny: the developer defines a catalog of components, and a language model builds and updates an interface as users describe what they need. You can install it with: install.packages("shinygenui") Or get the development version from GitHub: pak::pak("nanxstats/shinygenui") Apparently, language models are unsupervised multitask learners, but that’s so 2019.
